configuration_rationale: Preregistered daytime order/repeatability diagnostic on verified real SF1 and unchanged existing Q1 aggregation. Q1 selected from prior diagnostic service times (~2.5 seconds), giving a real query-first observation opportunity without slowing SQL or fabricating load. Separate dedicated metadata/query/maintenance sessions; refresh the completed query session after commit. Fresh metadata captured before the treatment query, actual action windows captured just before maintenance, existing 2-second freshness, complete 60/300-second history, real task overlap, original-snapshot controls and exact row/query conservation retained. No additional Spark metadata jobs deliberately inserted while the treatment query runs. Active-task REST observation and actual submission order verified from raw records. No missed-overlap retry, cache flushing, generated demand, policy constant, synthetic target, training or scheduling claim. A ninety-minute operational no-new-operation budget covers four sequential diagnostic episodes and auditing; it is not a cost observation horizon. All active work finishes naturally.

telemetry.rationale: One-second real host counter cadence, five-minute warmup plus five-second margin; retain existing 95% coverage and two-second gap/freshness gates. Exact bounds/available frontier and actual submission freshness are independently checked. No normalized demand assumed.
